body.name: Sparse singleton-branch switching protocol--slice record \(R_{\mathrm{sw}}\)
body.construction:
Put \(q_M=\lceil\log_2(M+1)\rceil\), and index \(\Omega\) canonically by \(1,\ldots,M\).  A sparse switching record is
\[
 R_{\mathrm{sw}}=(b_S,b_{\ell},b_{\alpha},b_T,\tau).
\]
Here \(b_S\in\{0,1\}^{|\mathcal A|}\), \(b_{\ell}\in\{0,1\}^{|\mathrm{LIT}|}\), \(b_{\alpha}\in\{0,1\}^{q_M}\), and \(b_T\in\{0,1\}^{V\sqcup(V\times\mathrm{LIT})}\).  A decoded value \(b_{\alpha}\in\{1,\ldots,M\}\) names exactly one concrete branch \(\alpha\in\Omega\), and \(\tau\) is one self-delimiting ancestor--district transcript for that branch.  The value \(b_{\alpha}=0\) is reserved for an empty paid-protocol or padding record; for such a record \(b_{\ell}\) and \(b_T\) are the designated all-zero sentinels and \(\tau\) is empty.  Every other bit pattern for \(b_{\alpha}\) is invalid.  The fixed-width part has exactly
\[
 |\mathcal A|+|\mathrm{LIT}|+q_M+|V|(1+|\mathrm{LIT}|)
\]
bits.
